name: lucas-claude-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins for building apps: machine setup, reviews and skill writing (starter), app UI and UX standards (dev).

plugins.name: starter
plugins.description: One-shot Claude Code onboarding (CLAUDE.md framework, permissions, git guard hook, plugins, MCP servers and CLIs per stack), a cheap single-pass review, a heavier multi-agent review sized by the diff, HTML reports, the craft of writing skills and CLAUDE.md files, and a pass that strips the generated look from pages and copy.

plugins.name: dev
plugins.description: Standards for building apps: a blueprint for apps with data, roles and foreign systems; the shell of an internal data app (breadcrumb path, right-hand detail panel, dialogs, tables); desktop and phone shells for consumer apps and PWAs; interface states and forms; rules for charts and data stories. Relies on starter for remove-ai-tells.

metadata.description: Two plugins: starter carries a way of working (setup, review, writing skills); dev carries the UI and UX standards for the apps built with it.
